_doc: Fit trials on one setup. per_side_mm is the clearance per side as designed in CAD (per_side_basis cad_nominal), not a caliper measurement of the print; the outcome was judged by hand. Fields: axis = hole axis in the PRINT pose (vertical = along print Z, horizontal = in the bed plane, unknown = not recorded); target_fit = the fit the trial was designed for (null for a clearance sweep with no target); observed_fit = what the print did (press: held by interference; snug: no play, goes in by hand; slide: moves by hand; free: falls through or swings; fused: parts joined, no motion); passed = the trial did what it was for (a sweep step passes when its outcome is recorded). To pick a starting clearance for a fit, use only entries with passed true and observed_fit equal to the fit you want; a failed trial is a value to avoid, never a recommendation. Starting points to re-test on your printer, not values to copy. Printer for every entry: Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2, 0.4 nozzle, 0.2 mm layers.
